_meta.purpose: Screen the ~212 NEW human-immune immunopeptidome deposits from BROADER_DATA_SWEEP.json for anything that could re-power the ORIGINAL H4 KO-COLLAPSE gate: a GENETIC HARD-ESSENTIAL antigen-processing perturbation (B2M / TAP1 / TAP2 / TAPBP KO/knockdown/disruption, or natural B2M-mutant / HLA-loss) with a WT/control contrast, on a NON-A*02 (allele-disjoint) HLA background, with a PROCESSED ligandome (not raw-only). This is the loss-of-machinery/collapse test that IFN-gamma (opposite-sign, gain-of-machinery) data structurally cannot feed.
_meta.distinct_from_prior_docs: HARD_ESSENTIAL_KO_RESCAN.json already searched the held+312-project PRIDE pool (0 disjoint-allele KO found; PXD063813 = A*02 proteome-only). H4_MACHINERY_PERTURB_RESCAN.json already handled the IFN-gamma REFRAME (PXD014017 = 3 disjoint IFN-gamma backgrounds, WRONG SIGN for the KO-collapse gate). This screen covers ONLY the NEW sweep deposits against the ORIGINAL KO-collapse criteria; it does NOT re-report those.
_meta.gate_requirement_recap: PASS-eligible for the KO-collapse gate needs >=3 DISJOINT-ALLELE (non-A*02) hard-essential-KO<->WT immunopeptidome backgrounds with processed ligandome. Held public hard-essential collapse = HAP1 only, and (post-renormalization) HAP1/A375/THP-1/HeLa are ALL HLA-A*02:01 => ZERO disjoint-allele hard-essential backgrounds held.
_meta.disk_note: 3.1 GB free (df-checked). Pure metadata screen; no bulk files pulled.
_meta.method: ProteomeCentral PROXI per-accession metadata (title/keywords/species/instrument) for every priority candidate; federated ProteomeCentral keyword enumeration (immunopeptidome/ligandome/B2M/beta-2-microglobulin/TAP1/TAP2/TAPBP/tapasin/knockout) with KO-token regex scan; PRIDE v2 search API cross-check; paper lookups (Science 2025 cryptic-PDAC, JCI/Sci-Rep MCC MYCL/PRC1.1, ERAP/NKG2A) via WebSearch/WebFetch. Note: iProX/China-federated mirror throttled after ~6 queries (known BROADER_DATA_SWEEP blind spot); PRIDE-primary and per-accession routes were reliable.

headline.verdict: CRO for the hard-essential collapse claim STILL STANDS. None of the priority candidates nor the machinery-token federated scan surfaced a GENETIC hard-essential (B2M/TAP1/TAP2/TAPBP) KO<->WT immunopeptidome on a non-A*02 background. The sweep's machinery-perturbation cluster is entirely trimmer/editor (ERAP), upstream-regulator/epigenetic (MYCL/PRC1.1/USP7), infection, or antigen-discovery -- none is a hard-essential loss-of-machinery collapse on a disjoint allele. The single natural-B2M line in the sweep (PXD024248 HCT15/b2m) is the B2M-RECONSTITUTED (rescue) arm on an A*02:01+ background, not a disjoint KO contrast.

priority_candidates_triaged.title: Targeting ERAP enhances anti-tumor immunity by disrupting the NKG2A/HLA-E inhibitory checkpoint
priority_candidates_triaged.perturbation_class: TRIMMER/EDITOR aminopeptidase disruption -- NOT hard-essential machinery
priority_candidates_triaged.verdict: REJECT. ERAP is a peptide-trimming aminopeptidase (editor), the exact class the KO-collapse gate excludes and that HARD_ESSENTIAL_KO_RESCAN/H4_MACHINERY_PERTURB_RESCAN already rejected (PXD066752/PXD060575/PXD054491). 'Disrupting the immunopeptidome' = repertoire re-shaping, not hard-essential presentation collapse. No B2M/TAP/TAPBP KO.

priority_candidates_triaged.title: Systematic evaluation and modulation of HLA class I downregulation in Merkel cell carcinoma
priority_candidates_triaged.perturbation_gene: MYCL + non-canonical PRC1.1 (USP7) -- HLA-I REPRESSORS identified by genome-scale gain/loss-of-function screen; loss-of-repressor RESTORES HLA-I
priority_candidates_triaged.perturbation_class: UPSTREAM TRANSCRIPTIONAL/EPIGENETIC regulator (repressor) -- not a hard-essential APM gene; direction is GAIN of HLA-I (opposite of collapse)
priority_candidates_triaged.hla_background: 11 MCPyV+ patient-derived MCC lines, mixed genotypes (some carry B2M defects, but the perturbation is MYCL/PRC1.1, not a B2M/TAP/TAPBP KO<->WT contrast)
priority_candidates_triaged.wt_control_present: modulation arms present (repressor KO / USP7 inhibitor vs parental)
priority_candidates_triaged.verdict: REJECT. Most on-mission-looking candidate, but the genetic perturbation is of upstream HLA-I REPRESSORS (MYCL/PRC1.1/USP7) to RESTORE presentation (gain-of-machinery, wrong sign), not a hard-essential B2M/TAP/TAPBP KO causing collapse. Baseline HLA-I-low state is driven by viral/epigenetic repression, not a defined machinery-gene loss-of-function contrast. Does not feed the KO-collapse gate.

priority_candidates_triaged.title: Cancer-restricted cryptic antigens are targets for T cell recognition (Science 2025, PDAC, adk3487)
priority_candidates_triaged.hla_background: PDAC patient organoids (allele-diverse) but NO machinery perturbation
priority_candidates_triaged.verdict: REJECT. Pure antigen-discovery (ncHLAp); no B2M/TAP/TAPBP KO or any machinery WT/KO contrast. Belongs to the cryptic-antigen (PXD013649) axis, not the KO gate.

priority_candidates_triaged.title: HIF Regulates Multiple Translated Endogenous Retroviruses: Implications for Cancer Immunotherapy (ccRCC)
priority_candidates_triaged.perturbation_class: hypoxia/translation regulation -- not APM machinery KO
priority_candidates_triaged.wt_control_present: hypoxia vs normoxia (not a machinery-gene KO)
priority_candidates_triaged.verdict: REJECT. Hypoxia/HIF-driven ERV translation->presentation; no hard-essential B2M/TAP/TAPBP KO<->WT. Spans H2/H4 source axis, not the KO-collapse gate.

priority_candidates_triaged.title: Integrated Immunopeptidomic and Proteomic Analysis of COVID-19 lung biopsies
priority_candidates_triaged.wt_control_present: infected vs control tissue (not a machinery-gene KO)
priority_candidates_triaged.verdict: REJECT for KO gate. Valuable as same-sample P+L infection data (H4 source-material axis) but NO genetic hard-essential machinery KO. Not a collapse contrast.

priority_candidates_triaged.title: A transgenic mouse allows characterisation of the HLA-C*06:02 immunopeptidome in a model of psoriasis
priority_candidates_triaged.perturbation_class: single-allele HLA-C transgenic model, autoimmune context
priority_candidates_triaged.hla_background: HLA-C*06:02 (single allele; disjoint from A*02 on HLA-C) but NO machinery KO
priority_candidates_triaged.verdict: REJECT for KO gate. Allele-controlled (C*06:02) but no B2M/TAP/TAPBP KO or WT/KO collapse contrast. Useful only as an allele-controlled reference, not a machinery-perturbation background.

priority_candidates_triaged.title: HLA class I ligandome of HCT15/b2m
priority_candidates_triaged.perturbation_gene: B2M (HCT15 is a natural MSI B2M-mutant CRC line)
priority_candidates_triaged.perturbation_class: NATURAL B2M-mutant line, but THIS deposit is the B2M-RECONSTITUTED (HCT15/b2m rescue) arm
priority_candidates_triaged.hard_essential: B2M IS hard-essential, BUT the deposited line is the B2M-POSITIVE reconstitution (rescue), not a KO<->WT collapse contrast
priority_candidates_triaged.hla_background: HCT15 = HLA-A*02:01 / A*24:02 -> A*02-POSITIVE, NOT disjoint from the A*02 cluster
priority_candidates_triaged.wt_control_present: the deposit is the reconstituted line; no paired B2M-null immunopeptidome ligandome deposited alongside
priority_candidates_triaged.processed_ligandome_available: jPOST-primary (MHC ligandome); processed table access via jPOST native (FTP-only) -- not verified fetchable this run
priority_candidates_triaged.verdict: REJECT. (1) A*02:01+ -> not disjoint (adds nothing to the saturated A*02 axis). (2) It is the B2M-RESCUE arm (gain), not a KO-collapse contrast. Even the natural-mutant parental would only add another A*02 fold. Does not re-power the disjoint-allele collapse gate.

KO_token_hits_in_immune_slices: PXD063813 (B2M, A*02, proteome-only -- ALREADY LOGGED in HARD_ESSENTIAL_KO_RESCAN)
PXD015489 (proteasome cis-splicing viral, not a KO)
machinery_token_federated_scan.B2M_keyword_federated: only PXD039275/PXD039274 (MOUSE synaptosome/brain B2M interactomes -- off-axis, not immunopeptidome)
machinery_token_federated_scan.caveat: China-federated (iProX) mirror throttled after ~6 queries -- the BROADER_DATA_SWEEP-documented iProX NATIVE blind spot persists. No hard-essential-KO deposit was surfaceable via the reachable routes; the untapped iProX/jPOST native pool (IPX/JPST accessions that never federate) remains the only place an unseen disjoint-allele KO could still hide, and is re-swept-from-unblocked-host territory, not resolvable this run.

decisive_answer.question: Do the NEW sweep deposits add >=1 (ideally >=3) DISJOINT-ALLELE HARD-ESSENTIAL-KO immunopeptidome backgrounds to re-run the original collapse gate cross-allele without a CRO?
decisive_answer.combined_disjoint_hard_essential_backgro: 0 (held HAP1/A375 are both A*02:01 post-renormalization, contributing 0 disjoint; the sweep adds 0). Still 0 of the required >=3.
decisive_answer.cro_status: The CRO for the hard-essential disjoint-allele collapse claim STILL STANDS. The sweep's machinery cluster is trimmer/editor (ERAP, PXD052175), upstream epigenetic-repressor with GAIN-of-HLA direction (MYCL/PRC1.1/USP7, PXD025501), infection/discovery/allele-model -- none is a loss-of-hard-essential-machinery collapse on a non-A*02 allele.
decisive_answer.only_reframe_that_closes_it_on_public_da: The IFN-gamma MACHINERY reframe (PXD014017, 3 disjoint backgrounds -- see H4_MACHINERY_PERTURB_RESCAN) is the ONLY public route to a cross-allele machinery test, but it is the OPPOSITE SIGN (gain, not collapse) and does NOT satisfy the KO-collapse gate. If the decision strictly needs a hard-essential loss-of-machinery collapse across disjoint alleles, the CRO is unavoidable.
